clarification: The accepted N675unrestricted comparison permits arbitrary joint state pairs with DIFFERENT reference marginals and compares raw Umegaki relative entropies after each channel. N966instead compares conditional deficits D(outputrho||outputsigma)-D(rho_R||sigma_R)and relates them to SLD tangents with H_R=0; it does not identify arbitrary quantum equal-reference Umegaki order. N965has the separate classical stochastic-channel hypothesis. Keep each source inequality direction and constant. None of these restrictions can be dropped by matching the words complete, entropy or reference. N675standing programme acceptance remains in force; an older analytic-only review did not itself audit its other claims, and does not reopen their accepted programme status. N661is not promoted.
